tasks.title:
Build a preview-only aesthetic artifact titled “Artifact Garden.”

Purpose:

Test whether the artifact preview layer can render a cute, intentional, visually styled artifact after Phase 733 preview transport normalization.

Hard constraints:

- Preview-only

- Read-only

- No runtime mutation

- No execution bridge activation

- No database changes

- No route rewrites

- No persistence contract changes

- No artifact lifecycle authority changes

- No Matilda execution authority

Visual style:

- Overall mood: cute, soft, cozy, polished, lightly magical

- Background: warm cream or pale blush gradient

- Card background: soft ivory with gentle peach/pink accents

- Primary text color: deep plum or warm charcoal

- Secondary text color: muted mauve

- Accent colors: sage green, soft rose, honey gold, lavender

- Borders: rounded, soft, subtle rose or sage outlines

- Shadows: gentle, airy, not harsh

- Font feeling: friendly, rounded, editorial, easy to read

- Use clear spacing and hierarchy

- Avoid neon, dark cyber styling, harsh blue-on-black, or terminal aesthetics

Content structure:

Represent the system path as a garden:

Intent → Snapshot → Preview/Diff → Matilda → Execution → Reconciliation

Garden metaphor:

- Intent = little seed

- Snapshot = seed packet

- Preview/Diff = blooming flower

- Matilda = guardian lantern

- Execution = locked garden gate

- Reconciliation = watering can with checkmark

Required labels:

- “Preview-only”

- “Execution locked”

- “Matilda observes, does not execute”

- “Artifact Garden”

- “Read-only visual artifact”

Success criteria:

- The artifact should look intentionally designed, not like plain markdown

- Literal escaped newline sequences like \n\n should not appear

- Text should be readable against the background

- Visual hierarchy should be obvious

- Execution should clearly appear locked/not active

- The preview should feel cute, calm, and polished
